title: Simple ItemShop
description:
A lightweight item-for-item shop plugin for Paper 1.21.1. 
Place a sign on a chest, define what you're selling and what you want in return. No economy plugin required.
body:
Simple ItemShop is a lightweight plugin for Paper 1.21.1 servers that allows players to create item-for-item shops using a chest and a sign — no economy plugin or server currency required.

## How it works
Place a chest, put a sign on top with the following format:

```
[Sklep]
ITEM_ID AMOUNT
ITEM_ID AMOUNT
[Closed]
```

Example — selling 64 sugar_cane for 1 diamond:

![Screenshot showing closed chestshop (without items inside)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a1c536588c7318fa67565ba013f42f9e724ac481.png)

![Screenshot showing working chestshop (with items inside, ready to go)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b462d4c6d929aee1c50991d0d2d87ee7e7d0635c.png)

**Once you put the items in the chest, the sign automatically changes from [Closed] to [Open].** Other players can then click the sign to purchase. The chest is fully protected — only the owner can open or break it.

## Features
- Item-for-item trading, no economy plugin needed
- Automatic [Open]/[Closed] status on the sign
- Chest protection against other players, pistons and explosions
- PL/EN language support with a simple config
- LuckPerms compatible

## Permissions
- itemshop.create — create and destroy own shops
- itemshop.use — buy from shops
- itemshop.admin — manage any shop

## Commands
- /itemshop language pl|en — change language
- /itemshop reload — reload config

## Note
Currently the plugin uses [Sklep] (Polish for "shop") as the sign tag. Support for [Shop] will be added in a future update.
